source_scope: 35 selected source, fixture and build inputs match the Linux workspace byte-for-byte; not a hermetic whole-worktree release manifest.

execution.runtime: root native host CLI and product BPF, real digest-pinned isolated CoreDNS targets

target_assumption_corrected.description: The pinned CoreDNS 1.15.0 erratic truncate 1 endpoint alternates TC and non-TC replies, and returns 192.0.2.53 instead of the ordinary fixture answer 192.0.2.7. The second protocol package exposed an incorrect test assumption.
target_assumption_corrected.fix: Check consecutive TC/non-TC queries in each package; retain both actual responses and include question, actual reply and elapsed time in failures. Do not restart target between packages.

validation.clippy_command: cargo --config profile.dev.package.gewyvern.opt-level=2 clippy --locked --lib --bin gewyvern_validate --test native_validation_harness_tdd -- -D warnings

limits: One physical Linux host/kernel; direct IPv4/IPv6 UDP with small DNS A messages.
Product selects cgroup and UDP port, not individual sockets. The excluded socket was created outside that cgroup.
Full payload multiset equality is bounded to messages <=128 bytes; no ordering or cross-window transaction correlation claim.
Timeout is bounded absence of a reply, not an RCODE. No vulnerability classification or full DNS parser claim.
No AAAA, EDNS, DNSSEC, TCP fallback, DoH/DoT, recursive caching, sustained-load or performance proof.
No full IP-address retention or PID attribution in product packet facts; advisory unverified-local trust is preserved.
No protocol-count, status-maturity or release-artifact promotion. Initial failed diagnostic attempts are retained separately.
